1.text: Nuko abakoresha b'ikoro bose n'abanyabyaha baramwegera ngo bamwumve.

2.text: Abafarisayo n'abanditsi barabyivovotera bati “Uyu yiyegereza abanyabyaha, kandi agasangira na bo.”

4.text: “Ni nde muri mwe waba afite intama ijana akazimiza imwe muri zo, ntasige izindi mirongo urwenda n'icyenda mu gasozi, akajya gushaka iyazimiye kugeza aho ari buyibonere?

5.text: Iyo ayibonye ayiterera ku bitugu yishimye,

6.text: yagera mu rugo agahamagara incuti ze n'abaturanyi be akababwira ati ‘Twishimane kuko mbonye intama yanjye yari yazimiye.’

7.text: Ndababwira yuko mu ijuru bazishimira batyo umunyabyaha umwe wihannye, kumurutisha abakiranuka mirongo urwenda n'icyenda badakwiriye kwihana.

8.text: “Cyangwa umugore waba afite ibice cumi by'ifeza, yaburamo kimwe ntiyakongeza itabaza, agakubura mu nzu, akagira umwete wo gushaka kugeza aho akibonera?

9.text: Iyo akibonye ahamagara incuti ze n'abaturanyi be akababwira ati ‘Twishimane kuko mbonye igice nari nabuze.’

10.text: Ndababwira yuko ari ko haba umunezero mwinshi imbere y'abamarayika b'Imana, bishimira umunyabyaha umwe wihannye.”

11.text: Kandi arababwira ati “Hariho umuntu wari ufite abahungu babiri.

12.text: Umuhererezi abwira se ati ‘Data, mpa umugabane w'ibintu unkwiriye.’ Nuko agabanya amatungo ye.

13.text: Iminsi mike ishize umuhererezi ateranya ibintu bye byose, aragenda ajya mu gihugu cya kure, yayisha ibintu bye ubugoryi bwe.

14.text: Abimaze byose inzara nyinshi itera muri icyo gihugu, atangira gukena.

15.text: Aragenda ahakwa ku muntu wo muri icyo gihugu, amwohereza mu gikingi cye kuragira ingurube.

16.text: Yifuza guhazwa n'ibyo izo ngurube zaryaga, ariko ntihagira ubimuha.

17.text: Nuko yisubiyemo aribwira ati ‘Abagaragu ba data ni benshi kandi bahazwa n'imitsima bakayisigaza, naho jye inzara intsinze hano.

18.text: Reka mpaguruke njye kwa data mubwire nti: Data, nacumuye ku Yo mu ijuru no maso yawe,

19.text: ntibinkwiriye kwitwa umwana wawe, mpaka mbe nk'umugaragu wawe.’

20.text: Arahaguruka ajya kwa se.“Agituruka kure, se aramubona aramubabarira, arirukanka aramuhobera, aramusoma.

21.text: Uwo mwana aramubwira ati ‘Data, nacumuye ku Yo mu ijuru no mu maso yawe, ntibinkwiriye kwitwa umwana wawe.’

22.text: Ariko se abwira abagaragu be ati ‘Mwihute muzane vuba umwenda uruta iyindi muwumwambike, mumwambike n'impeta ku rutoki n'inkweto mu birenge,

23.text: muzane n'ikimasa kibyibushye mukibage turye twishime,

24.text: kuko uyu mwana wanjye yari yarapfuye none akaba azutse, yari yarazimiye none dore arabonetse.’ Nuko batangira kwishima.

25.text: “Ariko umwana we w'imfura yari ari mu murima, amaze kuza ageze hafi y'urugo yumva abacuranga n'ababyina.

26.text: Ahamagara umugaragu amubaza ibyabaye ibyo ari byo.

27.text: Aramubwira ati ‘Murumuna wawe yaje none so yamubagiye ikimasa kibyibushye, kuko amubonye ari muzima.’

28.text: “Undi ararakara yanga kwinjira, nuko se arasohoka aramwinginga.

29.text: Maze asubiza se ati ‘Maze imyaka myinshi ngukorera, ntabwo nanze itegeko ryawe. Ariko hari ubwo wigeze umpa n'agasekurume, ngo nishimane n'incuti zanjye?

30.text: Maze uyu mwana wawe yaza, wamaze ibyawe abisambanisha, akaba ari we ubagira ikimasa kibyibushye!’

31.text: Na we aramubwira ati ‘Mwana wanjye, turabana iteka kandi ibyanjye byose ni ibyawe,

32.text: ariko kwishima no kunezerwa biradukwiriye rwose, kuko murumuna wawe uyu yari yarapfuye none arazutse, yari yarazimiye none dore arabonetse.’ ”
